links.outcome: Readability of chatbot answers to low back pain questions (Flesch Reading Ease Score)
links.effect: Answers were 'reasonably difficult' to read, mean (SD) FRES 50.94 (3.06).
links.quote: Overall, LLM-chatbots provided answers that were 'reasonably difficult' to read, with a mean (SD) FRES score of 50.94 (3.06).

links.outcome: Accuracy of chatbot low back pain recommendations against clinical guidelines
links.effect: Of 120 responses yielding 1069 recommendations, 55.8% were accurate, 42.1% inaccurate and 1.9% unclear.
links.quote: Out of 120 responses yielding 1069 recommendations, 55.8% were accurate, 42.1% inaccurate and 1.9% unclear.

screen.reason: Evaluates commercial LLM chatbots on common low back pain patient questions for accuracy, readability, and presence of safety disclaimers, but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
